headlines.title: Trumps says the U.S. will 'only encourage superintelligence' in AI
headlines.description: President Trump said in his remarks at the United Nations General Assembly that the U.S. would "only encourage superintelligence" when it comes to AI development, a notable declaration as warnings about the potential catastrophic consequences of the technology have spread.

headlines.title: Filmed in Captivity: Inside Russia’s Prison Propaganda Machine
headlines.description: Russian captors force Ukrainian prisoners of war to record propaganda videos designed to rally domestic support for the invasion and sow division within Ukraine. The videos often haunt former captives long after their release. NBC News’ Jane Lytvynenko travels to Ukraine to uncover how this propaganda influences local communities and the lives of returning soldiers.

headlines.title: Hayden Panettiere died from accidental overdose of drugs, including fentanyl, coroner says
headlines.description: “Heroes” and “Nashville” star Hayden Panettiere’s death has been ruled an accident caused by the toxic effects of multiple drugs, including fentanyl, officials said Monday.

headlines.title: Video shows injured man on the ground after ICE mistakenly targets him
headlines.description: According to police, the man reported injuries to his head, neck, and teeth; DHS did not respond to questions about the man’s injuries or why ICE officers did not render aid to him.

headlines.title: Pennsylvania Gov. Josh Shapiro on AI: 'I don't think we can kick the can down the road'
headlines.description: In an interview with NBC News' Allan Smith, Pennsylvania Gov. Josh Shapiro discusses his approach to artificial intelligence and how the U.S. should not "kick the can down the road."

headlines.title: Poll: Most voters say Trump has hurt the economy as competitive midterm election looms
headlines.description: President Donald Trump’s sinking ratings threaten to drag down Republicans in November’s midterm elections, as voters blame him for high prices and a shaky economy, according to a new NBC News poll.

headlines.title: Nolan Wells’ family vows to ‘never stop’ seeking the truth after grand jury report
headlines.description: Nolan Wells’ parents and their attorneys called on Mississippi to continue pursuing a fuller picture of the “truth” in the teenager’s death at a press conference Tuesday.

headlines.title: Trump touts peace settlements he has brokered in remarks to United Nations
headlines.description: President Trump said it had been a "great honor" to help broker multiple peace deals between nations during his address to the United Nations General Assembly. The president also touted the praise and thanks he had received from the leaders involved in the deals.

headlines.title: GOP senator calls for subpoenaing Donald Trump Jr. and Hunter Biden over their business dealings
headlines.description: A Republican senator is calling for an investigation into the business dealings of Donald Trump Jr. and Hunter Biden following the revelation that a Russian oligarch paid for Trump Jr.’s post-wedding festivities in the Caribbean earlier this year.

headlines.title: Lionel Richie undergoes heart procedure, will ‘take some time off’
headlines.description: Lionel Richie underwent a heart procedure which could cast doubt on an upcoming Las Vegas residency and other shows, a representative for the famed singer and producer said Tuesday.
